unified.intro: Describe the outcome you want. Review external actions before they run, then follow the verified result.
unified.goal: What would you like to do?
unified.goalPlaceholder: Read https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World and help me understand the project
unified.routeHint: Automatic routing supports public GitHub repository URLs. Other goals may need a model or project. Desktop actions begin with a fresh observation in Computer.
unified.paths: Source files (one relative path per line)
unified.modelConsent: Send this goal and the selected project sources to {provider} / {model}.
unified.observeFirst: Open Computer, select the target window and observe its controls before preparing an action.
unified.noGoals: No goals yet. Start with a public GitHub URL or choose a task type.
unified.staleApproval: This approval expired or its connection changed. Prepare a fresh action.
unified.networkConsent: Allow this exact request to contact the target shown above once.
unified.noReplay: The result needs checking. This action will not run again automatically. Verify the remote state before preparing a new action.
unified.untrusted: External content is untrusted data. It cannot authorize another action.
unified.reviewSummary: Review the context sent for summarization
unified.summaryConsent: Send the exact context above to this provider and model once.
unified.connectionsIntro: Connect an account or public resource with precise grants. Each external operation is reviewed separately.
unified.noConnections: No connections yet. A public GitHub repository can be used without a token.
unified.credentialHint: Tokens are stored locally using system credential protection and are never shown again. Leave blank when editing to keep the stored token. Other account services require a token; they are not connected automatically.
unified.grantConsent: Saving authorizes only the resource and operations shown here. Changing grants invalidates pending approvals.
unified.noActions: No external actions prepared. Create a goal to begin.
unified.evolutionIntro: Skill metrics come from recorded task evidence. Improvements stay pending until you review them.
unified.profileBoundary: Personal data belongs to this local app profile. Projects provide a narrower scope; separate operating system users require separate data directories.
unified.noMetrics: No measured skill uses in this scope yet.
unified.maintenanceHint: Preview expired, conflicting and old memory records before applying maintenance. High-priority and explicit memories are preserved. No records are deleted.
unified.pendingHint: Draft improvements stay pending. Review all instructions and allowed tools before approving and activating a new version.
unified.noCandidates: No pending improvements in this scope.
unified.prepareHint: Choose an exact granted resource and operation. Preparation makes no network request. Review the resulting request before approving.
unified.calendarUTC: Times use UTC. Convert your local time before preparing.
unified.mcpUnknown: A tool response does not prove its external effects. Tool calls may require manual verification.
unified.compositionHint: Choose enabled, reviewed skills from this scope. Every dependency is pinned to its exact version and checksum.
unified.noDependencies: No enabled, reviewed skills are available in this scope.
unified.compositionTools: Allowed tool union from the selected versions:
unified.compositionLimit: Composition combines reviewed instructions. Only the registered changed-package Go test step is currently executable. Dependencies are rechecked when used.
unified.compositionConsent: I reviewed the exact dependency versions, instructions and allowed tools above. Create and enable this composition.
unified.identityNotVerified: Account identity has not been verified. Add an account verification grant, then prepare and approve that read.

errors.UNIFIED_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED: Open Computer and observe the target controls before preparing a desktop action.
errors.UNIFIED_WORKSPACE_REQUIRED: Choose a project before creating this task.
errors.UNIFIED_CONTEXT_CHANGED: The reviewed context changed. Preview it again before sending.
errors.UNIFIED_RESULT_REQUIRED: A verified external result is required before summarization.
errors.CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED: Add an access token for this account before preparing this operation.
errors.CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE: The stored token cannot be read. Enter it again using this operating system account.
errors.CONNECTOR_SCOPE_DENIED: This resource and operation are outside the saved grants. Review the connection grants.
errors.CONNECTOR_REVISION_CHANGED: The connection changed. Prepare a new action and review it again.
errors.CONNECTOR_APPROVAL_MISMATCH: The action does not match the reviewed approval. Prepare and review it again.
errors.CONNECTOR_APPROVAL_EXPIRED: This approval expired. Prepare a fresh action.
errors.CONNECTOR_APPROVAL_CONSUMED: This approval was already used. Check the result before preparing another action.
errors.CONNECTOR_ORIGIN_DENIED: This service origin is not allowed. Review the connection address.
errors.CONNECTOR_INVALID: Check the service, exact resource, grants and request fields.
errors.CONNECTOR_NETWORK_FAILED: The service could not be reached. Check the recorded result before preparing another action.
errors.CONNECTOR_HTTP_REJECTED: The service rejected the request. Check the token, account permissions and request details.
errors.CONNECTOR_RESPONSE_INVALID: The service returned an unexpected response. Review the recorded evidence.
errors.CONNECTOR_READBACK_FAILED: The result could not be read back. Verify the remote state before trying another action.
errors.CONNECTOR_READBACK_MISMATCH: The remote result did not match the approved action. Verify it manually before continuing.
errors.CONNECTOR_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: This service cannot independently confirm the result. Verify the external state manually.
errors.CONNECTOR_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: This interrupted action needs manual verification. It will not be replayed automatically.
errors.CONNECTOR_STOPPED: External operations are stopped. Resume intentionally before preparing a new action.
errors.CONNECTOR_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED: The account identity has not been confirmed. Prepare and approve an identity verification read.
